_comment: acceptance line (D-001/D-002): dual threshold (target/danger) per deployment profile. kind=measure rows are RECORDED-ONLY - a breach is evidence, never a job failure; kind=assert/smoke rows are the only hard-fails under --gate enforce. Absolute-memory rows carry dagger-provisional values until the self-hosted representative run locks them. Mode B SSE buffering is a Registered Exemption, not a failure.
basis: decision-ledger D-001/D-002 (+D-005 fix-1); supersedes the prior D-004 single-threshold budget table

profiles.vps-headless: low-resource Linux VPS (~1C/1G): egressapikey-headless + resin sidecar, Mode B data plane
profiles.windows-desktop: standard Windows desktop: Tauri GUI + WebView2 tree + sidecar, Mode A shell forwarder

env.cpuCap: unpinned by default (matches production); BENCH_CPU_PIN=1 = controlled-experiment pinning, host-contention-sensitive
env.memUnitLinux: VmRSS (peak + p95 over steady window, warmup excluded)
env.memUnitWindows: WorkingSet64 descendant-tree sum from the spawned app PID (never process-name matching - WebView2 is a shared runtime)
env.loadContext: 200 concurrent SSE streams through one mixed entry endpoint
env.sharedRunnerRule: windows-latest/ubuntu-latest numbers are warn-only reference columns; absolute gates activate on the self-hosted representative run only
env.sutScope: phases.idle/soak measure the bench SUT data-plane set (resin sidecar + bench-forwarder when --forwarder resolves). The VPS-profile full tree (egressapikey-headless + sidecar) is measured by phases.headless/headlessstart when --headless-exe resolves (self-hosted representative run; skipped otherwise), and the desktop tree by phases.app/appstart on the windows leg

items.desc: SSE TTFB added delta, paired (Mode A leg when forwarder present, else Mode B forward-GET)
SSE event-gap added delta: good-event ratio, single metric two layers - target @10ms window (warn), danger @500ms window (breach). Mode A shell CONNECT tunnel; Mode B exempt.
SSE hard behavior assertions: per-event flush / disconnect-cascade cancel / bounded backpressure / in-band error (asserted on the Mode A leg when the forwarder ran)

items.exemption: mode-b-sse-buffering: Resin forward-GET SSE path is io.Copy-buffered; registered until upstream adds per-event flush. Evidence recorded at phases.sse.modeB / phases.sse.assertions.flush.modeB.
items.desc: Mode B forward-path SSE buffering - Registered Exemption (removal condition: upstream SSE-specific flush)
paired added latency p99 (full-link direct-vs-proxied)
throughput achievement: achieved rate / offered 500 rps
throughput error rate during the fixed-rate run (errors+non200)/sent
proxy-added p99 latency vs concurrent direct baseline during the fixed-rate run

idle RSS of the bench SUT process set (sidecar + shell forwarder when the Mode A leg ran) steady state - provisional until representative hardware; the VPS deployment tree (egressapikey-headless + sidecar) is out of this harness's spawn scope, caliber recorded in env.sutScope
SUT process set RSS at 200 concurrent SSE streams (sidecar + forwarder; provisional)
200-stream soak: all connected, zero unexpected closes, resin alive at end
windows desktop whole process-tree WorkingSet (descendants of spawned PID; webview2 subgroup at phases.app.webview2MB) - provisional
cold start -> MainWindowTitle ready, N runs p50 (median, same distribution as the p95 row)
cold start -> MainWindowTitle ready, N runs p95 (Defender/cold-disk variance absorbed by the distribution)
every cold-start launch reaches MainWindowTitle == EgressAPIKEY (ADR-0072 liveness)

idle RSS of the FULL headless process tree (egressapikey-headless + resin sidecar + descendants) — descendant-boundary sum: /proc PPid BFS on Linux, CIM descendant walk on Windows (same caliber as the desktop app tree). Closes the acceptance-line idle-tree boundary for the vps-headless profile; provisional until the representative-hardware run

headless cold start -> control surface TCP-ready, N fresh launches (the sidecar boots inside the timed span; the headless analogue of the desktop MainWindowTitle liveness caliber). Measure-only: no legislated headless startup threshold this round
sidecar spawn to first /healthz 200 (recorded; gate pending)

replace_ports full-map commit latency p99 over 200 sequential writes (file-backed WAL). Ex-push-gate duration bound (the D-004 <=50ms budget) demoted to a recorded row per r12-wave-i D-004 - the benchmark body still runs in cargo test, the assertion does not gate

DbPool writer-lock acquisition-wait p99 under the synthetic saturation hammer (regression/A-B readout; arm ii discharged 2026-09-24). Ex-push-gate hang-pathology bound (p99<250ms) demoted likewise; read-domain counters land alongside under phases.dbprobe.*OverThreshold

meta.evidence: locks carried from bench-results/results.json local run 2026-09-14 (results.ci=null); first CI bench.yml dispatch with the new harness supersedes them
decisions: assert rows beyond the legislated set are implementation decisions, registered here: appstart-title-match (every cold-start launch reaches the window title - the acceptance line's own smoke semantics), soak-200-streams-alive (all streams connected + zero unexpected closes), rps-error-rate (kind=measure, never hard-fails). They hard-fail only under --gate enforce; the default warn gate keeps them as recorded evidence.
sse-eventgap-goodratio expresses the legislated single-metric two-layer caliber via dangerMeasure (same ratio, wider 500ms window for the danger layer)

idle-rss-mb/soak-rss-mb scope = bench SUT process set (sidecar + forwarder). The full VPS deployment tree moved IN scope in r12-wave-b: headless-idle-tree-mb + headless-coldstart-ready-ms measure egressapikey-headless + sidecar via descendant-tree sampling (same caliber as the desktop tree) when --headless-exe resolves
